title: Error Handling, Logging & Observability
scope: Analyze error classes, retry semantics, logging conventions, and observability (vis/).

error_model.base_exception: KimiCLIException(Exception) - root for all kimi-cli-specific errors

soul/__init__.py: LLMNotSet(Exception) - raised when no LLM configured
LLMNotSupported(Exception) - raised when LLM lacks required capabilities (carries llm, capabilities)
MaxStepsReached(Exception) - raised when max_steps limit exceeded (carries n_steps)
soul/kimisoul.py: BackToTheFuture(Exception) - raise to revert context to a previous checkpoint
wire/types.py: QuestionNotSupported(Exception) - web mode does not support the Question tool
tools/utils.py: ToolRejectedError(ToolError) - from kosong.tooling, wraps rejected tool results
ToolError / ToolOk / ToolRuntimeError - inherited from kosong.tooling

external_kosong_errors: RetryableChatProvider - protocol marker for retryable providers

structured_error_codes.description: Maps an exception to (error_type, status_code) tuple for structured telemetry

pydantic_validation_handling.description: ValidationError (pydantic v2) caught at deserialization/serialization boundaries and wrapped into typed KimiCLIException subclasses
catch_sites: soul/context.py (~490) - Message.model_validate from JSONL, logs error + line number, skips record
agent.py - ValidationError on agent spec -> AgentSpecError
background/store.py - ValidationError on background task state

error_propagation.cli_entrypoint: cli/__init__.py:848-875 - catches all exceptions; typer.BadParameter/typer.Exit re-raised; click.ClickException re-raised; logger.exception('Fatal error when running CLI'); debug mode shows full traceback, non-debug shows concise message + log path
error_propagation.mcp_config: acp/__init__.py / cli/mcp.py - ValidationError caught, wrapped as MCPConfigError
error_propagation.system_prompt: agent.py - Jinja2 errors caught, wrapped as SystemPromptTemplateError
error_propagation.tool_results: ToolResult with is_error=True boolean flag - surfaced as ToolReturnValue for error attribution in telemetry and vis

retry_policy.httpx: httpx==0.28.1 - used in cli/plugin.py for plugin downloads (httpx.stream, 60s timeout, catches httpx.HTTPError)

llm_step_retry.retryable_errors: APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError, APIEmptyResponseError, APIStatusError with status in _RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES {408,409,429,500,502,503,504,529} or RetryableChatProvider; 429 with Retry-After

connection_recovery.description: Layered recovery: (1) 401 -> OAuth token refresh + retry (single attempt, gated on provider.oauth), (2) APIConnectionError/APITimeoutError -> recreate chat provider + retry (single attempt), (3) fallback to retry-exhausted error

oauth_token_refresh_retry.cross_process_lock: acquire_with_retry() - _CROSS_PROCESS_LOCK_RETRIES attempts with random backoff (1 + random.random() seconds)
oauth_token_refresh_retry.rejected_refresh_token: _can_retry_rejected_refresh_token() - cooldown-based (UNAUTHORIZED_REFRESH_RETRY_COOLDOWN_SECONDS), retries 401 on refresh token if cooldown elapsed
oauth_token_refresh_retry.anonymous_fallback: on 401 -> retry request without auth token (anonymous)

telemetry_transport_retry.backoff: RETRY_BACKOFFS_S = (1.0, 4.0, 16.0) - exponential backoff, 4 total attempts max
telemetry_transport_retry.fallback: transient failures exhausted -> disk persistence (failed_*.jsonl), retried on next startup

lazy_import.mechanism: _LazyLogger class - defers loguru import until first use; logger.disable('kimi_cli') by default for library usage; app entrypoints call logger.enable('kimi_cli')

stderr_redirect.mechanism: dup2 swap of process fd=2 to pipe read by background thread ('kimi-stderr-redirect') -> logged at ERROR level by default
stderr_redirect.purpose: captures C-level and unpythonic stderr output into loguru file sink

console_stderr_web.config: logger.remove(); logger.add(sys.stderr, level=LOG_LEVEL env var, default WARNING) for uvicorn server logging

log_levels.debug_mode: logger.enable('kosong') additionally enabled; TRACE level for log file
log_levels.normal_mode: INFO level for log file; stderr redirect catches only ERROR
log_levels.structured_fields: extra['sid'] injected via _patch_session_id patcher (ContextVar from soul.toolset.get_session_id)

structured_logging.fields: loguru extra fields: sid (session_id), standard {time, level, name, function, line, message}
structured_logging.interpolation: loguru keyword interpolation: logger.info('msg', key=value, name=name)
structured_logging.opt_pattern: logger.opt(depth=N) for call-site attribution; logger.log(level, msg, **kwargs) for dynamic levels

telemetry_system.design: Zero-dependency core: track() works before sink is attached; events buffered in deque(maxlen=1000) flushed once Sink is ready
telemetry_system.event_flow: track() -> _event_queue (deque, thread-safe) -> EventSink.accept() -> AsyncTransport.send() -> HTTP POST to https://telemetry-logs.kimi.com/v1/event
telemetry_system.flush_policy: EventSink - FLUSH_INTERVAL_S=30s timer OR FLUSH_THRESHOLD=50 events (whichever first), batched POST
telemetry_system.transport: AsyncTransport using aiohttp POST with 10s timeout (SEND_TIMEOUT); 401 -> retry without auth token; on failure -> disk persistence (failed_*.jsonl, 0o600 perms, 7-day max age, retried on next startup via retry_disk_events())
telemetry_system.trace_id: ContextVar _trace_id_var in kimisoul.py - set by _set_trace_id() from kosong trace_callback; included in all telemetry events and wire messages
telemetry_system.privacy: events contain no user message content, no file paths in exception messages - crash handler sends only exception class name

event_types_tracked: tool_call (outcome: success/error/cancelled, tool_name, tool_call_id, step_no, duration_ms, error_type, error_class, dup_type)
api_error (error_type, model, retryable, duration_ms, status_code, trace_id, input_tokens)
compaction_failed (source, tokens_before, duration_ms, round, retry_count, thinking_effort, error_type, trace_id)
background_task_created / completed / failed (outcome, duration_s, error_class, error_type)

crash_telemetry.mechanism: install_crash_handlers() - overrides sys.excepthook and loop.set_exception_handler; captures crash phase: startup/runtime/shutdown
crash_telemetry.privacy: only exception class name emitted (no message, no traceback, no file paths, no user input) to avoid PII

hook_system.event_types: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, StopFailure, SessionStart, SessionEnd, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, PostCompact
hook_system.payload_builders: hooks/events.py - typed dict builders (pre_tool_use, post_tool_use, post_tool_use_failure, user_prompt_submit, user_prompt_tool_mix, stop, session_start, session_end, subagent_start, subagent_stop, pre_compact, post_compact)
hook_system.execution: HookEngine triggers hooks -> HookResult (action: allow/deny, duration_ms, matched_rule) -> wire events HookTriggered / HookResolved emitted with OnTriggered/OnResolved callbacks

wire_protocol.transport: JSONL over stdout/stdio (web runner) or file (wire.jsonl)
wire_protocol.message_envelope: WireMessageEnvelope { type: str (ClassName), payload: dict } - model_dump(mode='json') on send, model_validate() on receive; flatten_union() resolves Union/TypeAliases to flat class tuple for isinstance dispatch
wire_protocol.event_types: TurnBegin, TurnEnd, SteerInput, StepBegin, StepEnd, StepInterrupted, StepRetry, ToolCall, ToolResult, HookTriggered, HookResolved, CompactionBegin, CompactionEnd, MCPLoadingBegin, MCPLoadingEnd, StatusUpdate, Notification, ApprovalRequest, ApprovalResponse, QuestionRequest, QuestionResponse, SubagentEvent, PlanDisplay, BtwBegin, BtwEnd, ToolReturnValue, MCPStatusSnapshot
wire_protocol.step_retry_wire: StepRetry(n, next_attempt, max_attempts, wait_s, error_type, status_code) - emitted during tenacity retry before sleep
wire_protocol.status_update: StatusUpdate { context_usage, context_tokens, max_context_tokens, token_usage: {input, output, cache_read, cache_creation, other}, plan_mode, mcp_status, agent_state, current_step }

proposal.summary: kimi-cli uses loguru (lazy-imported via _LazyLogger) for structured logging with log-level interpolation and session-ID context injection, tenacity for LLM/compaction retry with exponential-jitter backoff, a zero-dependency in-memory-buffered telemetry module (track->EventSink->AsyncTransport) that sends batched events to an external endpoint with disk persistence fallback, and an embedded FastAPI + React 19 vis/ sub-application that renders wire-protocol events into five interactive observability views (wire events, context messages, session state, dual-view, agents panel) with built-in integrity scoring (event pairing validation), tool-level success/failure metric dashboards, anomaly detection, and error navigation.
proposal.pydantic_v2_pattern: The codebase leverages pydantic v2's model_dump(mode='json') and model_validate() on a WireMessageEnvelope {type: ClassName, payload: dict} to serialize/deserialize a polymorphic event stream of 20+ typed BaseModel subclasses (e.g., ToolCall, ToolResult, StepRetry, StatusUpdate), using flatten_union() from utils/typing.py to resolve Union/TypeAliasType into a flat tuple of concrete classes for runtime isinstance() dispatch and deserialization. ValidationError is caught at deserialization boundaries (soul/context.py loading Message.model_validate from JSONL, acp/mcp.py wrapping as MCPConfigError, session state loading) with structured logging of the error and the skipped record's line number - this pattern keeps validation failures visible in the error/observability pipeline without crashing the session, while the structured (type, payload) wire format enables the vis/ frontend to render rich, typed event cards, compute integrity scores, and emit tool-level error attribution (ToolResult with is_error=True detected by isErrorEvent()).
recommendations: Standardize error code taxonomy across KimiCLIException subclasses - currently error types are implicitly encoded in telemetry event names; an explicit ErrorCode enum (mirroring the classify_api_error error_type set) would allow the CLI and vis/ frontend to correlate structured errors consistently.
Consider adding loguru structured serialization (logger.serialize=True) as an opt-in debug sink alongside the plain-text file sink to enable log aggregation tools to consume JSON log records.

The tenacity retry configuration (max_retries_per_step, wait exponential-jitter min/max) is centralized in soul/kimisoul.py; documenting these as explicit constants or a RetryConfig pydantic model would make the retry policy discoverable and testable.

Add unit tests for classify_api_error() and _is_retryable_error() - currently no dedicated test coverage for the error classification mapping that drives both retry decisions and telemetry event payloads.
Consider adding a 'network_errors' view in the vis/ wire viewer to visualize APIConnectionError/APITimeoutError patterns and their correlation with StepRetry events across turns.

pydantic_ai_2_impl.pattern: Typed Error Envelope + Model-Retry Feedback Loop
pydantic_ai_2_impl.why_now: kimi-cli's tenacity retry on _kosong_step_with_retry re-sends the SAME prompt N times without feeding error context to the model. LLMs keep failing because errors are swallowed by the retry layer - the model never sees what went wrong, so each retry is a blind roll of the dice. Pydantic-ai v2's ToolError surfaces structured error envelopes (error_type, status_code, retryable) directly in the model's message history, enabling self-correction on each retry attempt instead of blind re-execution.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.harness_gap: Current approach in soul/kimisoul.py: @tenacity.retry on _kosong_step_with_retry() with classify_api_error() mapping exceptions -> error_types, _before_step_retry_sleep emitting StepRetry wire events. Gap: no typed error envelope enters the model context. ToolResult with is_error=True is only for telemetry/vis rendering (wire/types.py ToolResult), not for model feedback. The tenacity retry re-invokes the LLM API call but never injects 'you got HTTP 429 rate_limit' into the conversation. Pydantic-ai v2 fix: ToolError(LLMErrorEnvelope.model_dump_json()) makes the error visible as a structured tool result; retries=3 on @agent.tool triggers framework-managed retry where the model sees the error_type and retryable flag and self-corrects. This closes the silent-error-swallow gap between kosong.step() and the kimisoul retry loop.
